section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study investigating the association between trait gratitude and loneliness in a Dutch adult population over 40 years old. The study also assessed the mediating roles of psychological flexibility and engaged living. Findings indicated a negative association between gratitude and loneliness, fully mediated by psychological flexibility and partially by engaged living.
